Lina Kwong: hey finance — quick question. I bought a small run of conference keychains & a couple of stickers at SFO on the corp card. Merchant on the statement shows up as 'A1RMALL' and the terminal only printed a short slip (no VAT or itemization). Charge was $58.23 on 2026-03-18. Can I submit this for reimbursement as marketing swag and is the short slip okay?
Marta (Finance): hi Lina — thanks for flagging. For small marketing purchases we usually accept, but we need either an itemized receipt or manager approval + missing receipt form. Can you attach a photo of the slip and a screenshot of the card statement line? Also confirm whether these were client gifts or general conference swag.
Lina Kwong: attaching two pics in the thread (receipt_photo.jpg, card_stmt.png) — receipt literally shows: "A1RMALL" and a 4-digit terminal code, total only. No VAT breakdown. These were handed out at our booth during the meetup (not client gifts).
Marta (Finance): that sounds fine. Process: 1) upload receipt photo + card stmt to the expense in Expensify (or our expense UI), 2) fill the missing receipt form: https://intranet.redwood/finance/missing-receipt (use the "missing small receipt" option), 3) tag cost center and project. Please use category `MKT-SWAG` and project code `CONF-SFQ24`. We also need manager approval note in the expense. For foreign currency — looks like USD here so use bank conversion shown on the card stmt.
Lina Kwong: got it. @Kevin L can you approve this for reimbursement?
Kevin L (Manager): approved — confirms these were for the booth and under $100. Fine to reimburse. :white_check_mark:
finance-bot: Expense ticket created: EXP-4821. Please attach all files to the ticket or reply with links. Reimbursement will be in the next payroll cycle once the expense is submitted and coded.
Marta (Finance): thanks everyone. Lina — once you attach the photos + missing receipt form and mark the expense `approved by manager` we'll process. If Expensify gives you any warning about merchant name mismatch, add a short note: "merchant prints as A1RMALL; actual purchase at SFO airside retail."
